name: Obsidian
logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><polygon points="50,15 82,32 82,68 50,85 18,68 18,32" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8"/><line x1="50" y1="15" x2="50" y2="85" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="6"/><line x1="18" y1="32" x2="82" y2="68" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="18" y1="68" x2="82" y2="32" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/></svg>
tagline: A sharp, local-first knowledge base on top of plain text Markdown files.
replacesDetailed: Replaces Notion's sluggish database loading spinners, cloud vendor lock-in, offline sync failures, and bloated workspace navigation with instant local files you own forever.
targetAudience: Researchers, developers, students, writers, and knowledge workers who value complete data sovereignty and instant search.

learningCurve.summary: Starts simple as a markdown editor. Learning bi-directional linking and community plugins unlocks superpower status.

pricing: 100% Free for personal use, optional $4/mo Sync
affiliatePerk: 100% free forever for personal use with zero lock-in

lessonPlan.title: Obsidian De-Bloated: Building an Eternal Second Brain in Markdown
lessonPlan.subtitle: Say goodbye to cloud lag. Organize your notes with bi-directional links and pure plain text.
lessonPlan.overview: Notion is great until your database hits 5,000 records and every click takes 4 seconds. Obsidian operates directly on local `.md` files on your hard drive, guaranteeing that your notes will remain readable 50 years from now.
prerequisites: Obsidian installed on your desktop or phone
A folder on your computer designated as your 'Vault'

steps.title: Creating Your First Local Vault
steps.description: Initialize your note vault in a local directory (e.g. iCloud, Dropbox, or local SSD).
actionItems: Open Obsidian and click 'Create new vault'.
Name it (e.g., 'CoreVault') and select a folder path on your drive.
Verify that notes created are simple `.md` files viewable in any text editor.
steps.proTip: Avoid putting your vault in deeply nested subfolders. A simple `/Documents/Notes` folder is ideal.

steps.title: Bi-Directional Wiki-Linking (`[[Note Name]]`)
steps.description: Ditch rigid folder hierarchies in favor of natural networked thoughts.
actionItems: Type `[[Project Alpha]]` inside any note to create an instant backlink.
Click on the newly created link to auto-generate the destination page.
Open the 'Backlinks' panel on the right sidebar to see all references connecting back.
steps.proTip: Use aliases by typing `[[Project Alpha|Alpha]]` to display natural phrasing while linking to the core document.

steps.title: The Interactive Graph View
steps.description: Visualize how your thoughts, research, and projects interconnect in 2D space.
actionItems: Press 'Cmd/Ctrl + G' to open Graph View.
Use the color groups feature to highlight tags (e.g. #active = green, #archive = gray).
Adjust node repulsion and gravity for a balanced celestial view of your knowledge.
steps.proTip: Don't stress over making the graph look pretty early on; focus on writing, and the web will grow organically.

steps.title: Anti-Bloat Plugin Selection (Keep It Lean)
steps.description: Avoid plugin hoard syndrome. Install only the 3 essential community tools.
actionItems: Settings > Community Plugins > Turn on Community Plugins.
Install 'Dataview' for lightweight SQL-like queries over your notes.
Install 'Omnisearch' for lightning-fast fuzzy text and PDF search.
Skip cosmetic widgets that slow down startup time.
steps.proTip: Check 'Debug Startup Time' in Settings to ensure total vault boot remains under 300ms.

steps.title: Free Multi-Device Sync Options
steps.description: Keep notes synced across laptop and mobile without paying high monthly subscriptions.
actionItems: Option A: Sync via standard iCloud Drive or Google Drive / Syncthing.
Option B: Use the Git plugin to auto-push notes to a private GitHub repo.
Option C: Support the developers with official end-to-end encrypted Obsidian Sync.
steps.proTip: Because files are raw text, merge conflicts can be resolved using standard git diff tools.

name: Typora
logoSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="18" y="18" width="64" height="64" rx="12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M32 36H68M50 36V66" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
tagline: A truly distraction-free Markdown reader and editor with live seamless preview.
replacesDetailed: Replaces Word's endless ribbon menus, formatting corruptions, slow startup times, and heavy .docx file bloat with a tranquil, pure writing canvas.
targetAudience: Novelists, technical bloggers, academic researchers, and essayists who want words and typography to take center stage.

learningCurve.summary: Type markdown symbols and they immediately render into beautiful typography inline. Zero split-screen dissonance.

lessonPlan.title: Typora Mastery: Flow-State Writing Without Formatting Frustrations
lessonPlan.subtitle: Master inline live-rendering, mathematical formulas, and flawless PDF/HTML exports.
lessonPlan.overview: Word processors clutter your screen with 500 toolbar buttons you will never press. Typora eliminates split preview panes by rendering Markdown as you type, giving you pure typographic zen.
prerequisites: Typora installed on Windows, Mac, or Linux
A blank canvas ready to write

steps.title: The Live Preview Experience
steps.description: Learn how Typora collapses markdown syntax into formatted text instantly.
actionItems: Type `# Headline 1` and press Space or Enter to see it transform instantly.
Type `**bold text**` and `*italic text*` to witness inline rendering.
Click on any rendered word to reveal the underlying Markdown code for surgical edits.
steps.proTip: Press 'Ctrl + /' (or Cmd + /) to toggle raw source code mode whenever you want to inspect plain text.

steps.title: Focus Mode & Typewriter Scrolling
steps.description: Keep your current active sentence centered on screen to avoid neck strain.
actionItems: View > Toggle 'Typewriter Mode' (keeps current line pinned at vertical center).
View > Toggle 'Focus Mode' (dims all other paragraphs except the active sentence).
Press F11 / Cmd+Ctrl+F for Fullscreen borderless writing.
steps.proTip: Pair Focus Mode with ambient background noise for deep 90-minute writing sprints.

steps.title: Mathematical Formulas & Code Fences
steps.description: Write KaTeX formulas and syntax-highlighted code blocks effortlessly.
actionItems: Type `$$` and press Enter to open KaTeX display math block.
Type `\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2` to preview crisp vector mathematics.
Type ````javascript` to create a live highlighted code container.
steps.proTip: Typora supports Mermaid diagrams natively: type ````mermaid` to render instant flowcharts.

steps.title: Minimalist Themes & Custom CSS
steps.description: Choose high-readability typographic themes suited for print and digital reading.
actionItems: Open theme folder to inject custom Google Fonts or CSS font smoothing rules.
steps.proTip: The 'Newsprint' theme is calibrated with optimal line heights for long-form non-fiction.

steps.title: Flawless PDF & Docx Export
steps.description: Export clean client-ready PDFs with custom headers, page numbering, and table of contents.
actionItems: Set page margins to 20mm and check 'Generate Table of Contents'.
Notice how typography matches professional book printing standards.
steps.proTip: Install Pandoc to enable one-click export into EPUB, Word, and LaTeX.
